decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted numbered Design & Access Statement, Plan 1, Plan 2, Plan 3 Received 24/12/2010 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The premises shall be used for an education and training centre and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class D1 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).
Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted for an education and training centre purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times Monday-Friday 0900-1800 and Saturdays 0900-1300.
Condition : 5 - The permission hereby granted shall be for a limited period up to 23rd April 2013 when the use shall cease.
description: Continued use of Suite 6 as D1 training facility, change of use of Suite 14 to D1 training facility for a period to 23rd April 2013 to run with existing consent 00083/AL/P8 for suites 1, 3, 5, 12 and 15
